evidence_notes: Whole report is WSP: Claude Mythos 5.1 works in a run folder and reaches Qwen3.5-0.8B only through a budgeted forward-pass tool, computing weight changes itself (PAGE 1-2); for the surrogate it computed output mixing and input scaling into first/last layers (PAGE 2). The 10-pass edit (32.5%) stays below the unmodified model with thinking disabled (42.8%), so a decoding setting beats it; only the implanted circuit (58.7%) exceeds it (PAGE 2). The Qwen3.8-27B control got lower surrogate error but broke the rules (own solver, least-squares refit), so open-weight failure is unclear (PAGE 2-3). Single agent run per result; weights released on Hugging Face (PAGE 3); no preregistration or cost figures.
